description: Numeric ratchet for Orrery. Each entry has a current value (where the engine is now) and a target (what done means). Current values start at the failing baseline and only move toward target through verified runs. Targets that are tolerances trace to SPEC.md and to a cited source; they are never fabricated, and an invariant threshold flips from pending to a real measured current only when a committed test records it.

milestonesComplete.note: Milestone 1 (vectors, matrices, units, time, constants, seeded rng, compensated sum) is implemented and green.

testsPassing.note: Floor target: at least one passing test per acceptance criterion across all eight milestones (44 passing now plus 39 still-todo criteria).

testsTodo.note: Acceptance criteria for milestones 2 through 8, recorded as test.todo in test/roadmap.test.ts, each owed a real test.

testsFailing.note: A break push files a failing test first, which raises this above zero until the fix lands.

nanInfOccurrences.note: Hard invariant across every milestone: no NaN and no Infinity ever appears in a state, element, or derived quantity.

splitJdRoundTripError.note: Enforced now by src/core/time.test.ts within atol 1e-6 s over +/- 200 years; exact observed maximum not separately recorded.

keplerRoundTripError.note: COE to RV to COE round trip for well-conditioned orbits.

universalVsRegimeError.note: Two independent Kepler solvers must agree away from e = 1.

stumpffContinuityError.note: Closed form and Taylor series for C(z), S(z) must agree at the |z| ~ 1e-4 seam.

numericVsAnalyticLeapfrog.note: Velocity-Verlet leapfrog vs analytic Kepler, 1 to 10 orbits at h = period/1000. Loose start, tighten from a measured run.

numericVsAnalyticRK4.note: RK4 vs analytic Kepler over short horizons. Calibrate from a measured run.

maxEnergyDriftLeapfrog.note: Symplectic: bounded and non-growing, not secular. Bound calibrated from a measured envelope.

maxEnergyDriftPEFRL.note: Fourth-order symplectic: tighter bounded band than leapfrog. Calibrate from a measured envelope.

linearMomentumDrift.note: Equal-and-opposite force writes make this machine-noise level, independent of integrator order.

angularMomentumDrift.note: Symplectic methods, bounded and non-secular. Calibrate from a measured run.

replayByteIdentical.note: Same scene, seed, integrator, step, and step count yields byte-identical state on the pinned engine.

lambertEndpointError.note: Re-propagating the solved velocity recovers the target position.

lambertIzzoVsBmwError.note: Two independent Lambert solvers must agree on the single-rev solution.

earthMarsVinfError.note: Patched-conic excess speeds vs Curtis Example 8.8 (3.1651 and 2.8851 km/s). Loose to absorb textbook rounding.

lagrangeL4L5Error.note: L4/L5 are exact closed form (1/2 - mu, +/- sqrt(3)/2); only floating-point rounding error remains.

collinearResidual.note: Test the physics residual of the converged collinear Lagrange point, not a transcribed number.

jacobiDriftBound.note: Jacobi constant under leapfrog in the rotating frame: bounded oscillation, no secular growth. Bound set after the integrator is measured.
